# neuron v0.1.7 — stability and fixes

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). Installer and portable ZIP, with the app and CLI. Unsigned binaries; check `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit.

Stability improvements and issue fixes, including everything from the unpublished v0.1.6.

- **Macros:** safer by default, and OBS and Signal lighting work from BOUND macros.
- **Sharing:** importing a setup or profile asks before adding anything that runs code.
- **Devices:** better automatic lighting for newer BlackWidow keyboards, and M keys work on keyboards connected after startup.
- **Reliability:** no false stall warnings after sleep, a clean quit, and safer updates.

Addressed issues: #6, #11, #23, #30, #33.

No new hardware support is claimed. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.7/docs/STATUS.md).
